name: Connected Services — generic first-party MCP call
description: Calls the `connectors` first-party MCP catalog server (Connected Services — Gmail, Slack, etc.) directly over HTTP, without going through a browser or re-deriving the call shape each session. Use `available connectors` first to see this tool, then `run connectors-call --op list_catalog` (or list_connections/connect/poll/disconnect/call/execute/list_actions/describe_action) to drive it. Prefer `execute` for 'do something in a provider' — it runs backend-side with the vaulted token (works with Composio secret-masking ON) — over the raw `call` passthrough, which needs masking OFF. Prefer this over ad-hoc mcp__connectors__* calls when the SAME operation recurs across tasks — once a toolkit/method/path or toolkit/action shape is proven, note it in the tool's known_issues or promote a narrower wrapper tool for it.

op.description: the connectors MCP tool to invoke: list_catalog | list_connections | connect | poll | disconnect | call | execute | list_actions | describe_action

method.description: op:call — HTTP method for the generic passthrough (GET/POST/...)

args.description: JSON-encoded string of the remaining call arguments, parsed and merged into the request. op:call — body/query/etc. for the raw REST passthrough. op:execute — {"action":"<ACTION_NAME>","arguments":{...}} e.g. {"action":"GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL","arguments":{"recipient_email":"a@b.com","subject":"...","body":"...","is_html":false,"cc":[],"bcc":[]}}. op:list_actions — {"search":"...","limit":20} (both optional). op:describe_action — {"action":"<ACTION_NAME>"}. May carry PHI/PII (e.g. an email body) — marked secret so runs.jsonl (redact() in bin/breeze-tools.mjs) never persists it

output.result: the connectors MCP tool's structured result, unwrapped. op:list_actions returns [{action, description}]; op:describe_action returns {action, description, required[], properties{}}

dependencies: Must run inside an operator/task session — reads the TYPEBUILD_MCP_TOKEN the session already has in its PTY env (electron/browser/tools/mcp-client.mjs). No separate login/auth step.
known_issues: This is the GENERIC fallback tool — one call per invocation, args passed raw. If a specific (toolkit, method, path) or (toolkit, action) combination is used repeatedly, promote a narrower purpose-built tool.json/tool.mjs for it (breeze-tools create) rather than re-typing --args each time.
op:execute/call are mutating for some toolkits — check the connectors server's own response before assuming success; this wrapper does not retry mutating calls.

op:execute is the preferred 'do something' path (works with Composio secret-masking ON); op:call is a raw-token REST passthrough that needs masking OFF — prefer execute unless no action exists for the need.
